answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable onyx bond, slashed if peers prove a duplicate identity. New accounts start with a tiny delta of trust: only small, publicly auditable jobs, and each completed job raises their limit by a fixed delta after independent verifiers attest it. Monthly, a random gale audit samples accounts and forces them to re-prove work history on demand. An attacker with many fakes must pay the bond and pass audits for every copy, so cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Sybils become unprofitable, not just detectable.
